description: Add tokens to a price watchlist stored by SwapChan under your watchId. Triggers: upPct/downPct from the price when added (default ±10%), absolute above/below USD levels, and optionally a swap ({toChainId,toToken,amount in base units}) whose best route output is tracked so check_watches can flag a better route (>0.5%). Nothing is pushed: call check_watches whenever you want. Max 50 items per watchId. Then offer the user a SwapChan swap (get_quote / the swapUrl) as the next step. Result includes `display` markdown with chan images: show it to the user. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

chainId.description: Chain id (1, 8453, 42161, 10, 137, 56, 43114, 59144, 534352, 792703809 Solana, 8253038 Bitcoin, 728126428 Tron) or name (eth, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bnb, avalanche, linea, scroll, solana, bitcoin, tron).

amount.description: Base units of the watched token.

toChainId.description: Chain id (1, 8453, 42161, 10, 137, 56, 43114, 59144, 534352, 792703809 Solana, 8253038 Bitcoin, 728126428 Tron) or name (eth, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bnb, avalanche, linea, scroll, solana, bitcoin, tron).

watchId.description: Client-generated random id (8-64 chars [A-Za-z0-9_-]). Generate once, remember it; it is the only key to the list.

name: watch_token
title: Watch tokens (pull-based)
